scheme_name: Vasantrao Naik Merit Awards To The Vjnt Students Who Came First In State Or First In Board Of 10th And 12th Standard Examination
other_conditions: Student must belong to the VJNT category and be the first performer in the state or the board for the 10th or 12th standard examinations
benefits_summary: Award of ₹1,00,000 (trophy and certificate) for the top boy and girl in the state and ₹51,000 (trophy and certificate) for the top boy and girl in each board for both SSC and HSC exams.
